front.title: Architecture and Requirements for Autonomous Agent Observability, Control and Intervention

abstract.t:
This document defines architecture and a set of requirements for Observability, Control, and Intervention for Autonomous Agents. The Autonomous Agents can be any Agents such as Network management Agents or Security Agents.
It identifies gaps in existing mechanisms and specifies required interaction capabilities between Agent supervision systems and Autonomous Agents (such as Network Management Agents) across multi- vendor environments, specifically observability, control, and runtime intervention. The requirements aim to guarantee comprehensive, lifecycle control over Autonomous Agents and enable observation, constraint, intervention, and correction to ensure network operational resilience and continuity.
